notes: Large-unit check on לְ + בַּד + suffix → *alone*: the one English word carries the preposition's relation of separation, בַּד's own lexeme, and the 1cs reference (*by myself*), so rule 30's one-English-word condition is met for every morpheme and the grouping is retained, headed on בַּד. Splitting would leave two morphemes `unrepresented` beside one holding the whole word, which rules 22 and 30 forbid.
מִמֶּנָּה → *thereof* is one preposition-plus-suffix unit headed on the preposition, no relative standing in the clause (rule 22).
